We could not read the ANAS website from our server on 30 October 2026, so this page does not list single roads. citazioni.x: Fuori dai centri abitati, lungo le strade frequentemente interessate da precipitazioni nevose e fenomeni di pioggia ghiacciata (freezing rain) nel periodo invernale, gli enti proprietari o concessionari di strade possono, ai sensi dell’articolo 6, comma 4, lettera e), del decreto legislativo n. 285/1992, prescrivere che i veicoli a motore, esclusi i ciclomotori a due ruote e i motocicli, siano muniti di pneumatici invernali ovvero abbiano a bordo mezzi antisdrucciolevoli idonei alla marcia su neve e ghiaccio.
Se ne dovessero ricorrere le condizioni i comuni possono adottare gli stessi provvedimenti anche all’interno dei centri abitati ai sensi dell’articolo 7, comma 1, del decreto legislativo n. 285/1992.
L’obbligo è stabilito dall’ente proprietario della strada e reso noto mediante apposito cartello.

L’obbligo di avere a bordo catene o pneumatici invernali è anche indicato lungo le strade da appositi cartelli che mostrano le tratte interessate; inoltre, l’obbligo va osservato anche se non c’è neve.
Ad esempio, in alcune aree l’obbligo non viene applicato, come succede in diverse zone del Sud Italia. Al contrario, in alcune zone montane e nel Nord Italia le date possono essere modificate.

Ai fini della necessaria uniformità si dispone che il periodo interessato dall’obbligo sia ricompreso tra il 15 novembre e il 15 aprile e che il provvedimento sia redatto utilizzando come riferimento il modello in allegato A.

Resta impregiudicata la possibilità per gli enti proprietari di strade di adottare provvedimenti della stessa natura, con una estesa temporale diversa per strade o tratti di esse in condizioni particolari quali ad esempio strade di montagna a quote particolarmente alte.

Gli pneumatici da neve (detti anche invernali o termici), considerati dispositivi da utilizzare in alternativa alle catene da neve ai fini del Codice della strada, sono contraddistinti da apposita sigla del tipo M+S o MS o M-S o M&S e da determinati simboli della categoria di velocità.
Per tutte le altre tipologie di pneumatici è necessario dotarsi di catene a bordo.
Allo scopo di evitare interpretazioni non uniformi circa l’impiego dei mezzi antisdrucciolevoli, si chiarisce che i medesimi devono essere montati almeno sulle ruote degli assi motori.

Circolare con un veicolo senza osservare l’obbligo imposto di tenere montati (o avere a bordo) mezzi antisdrucciolevoli o pneumatici invernali idonei alla marcia su neve o ghiaccio, comporta una sanzione pecuniaria. Non sono previste sanzioni accessorie ma è intimato al conducente di non proseguire il viaggio se prima non si dota dei predetti dispositivi.

traduzioni.dir_strade: Outside built-up areas, on roads often affected by snowfall and freezing rain in winter, the owners or operators of roads may, under Article 6(4)(e) of Legislative Decree no. 285/1992, require that motor vehicles, except two-wheeled mopeds and motorcycles, have winter tyres fitted or carry anti-skid devices suitable for driving on snow and ice.
traduzioni.dir_comuni: If the conditions arise, towns may adopt the same measures inside built-up areas too, under Article 7(1) of Legislative Decree no. 285/1992.
traduzioni.pol_ente: The obligation is set by the owner of the road and made known by a specific road sign.
traduzioni.pol_cartelli: The obligation to carry chains or have winter tyres is also shown along the roads by specific signs that mark the sections concerned; also, the obligation applies even if there is no snow.
traduzioni.pol_zone: For example, in some areas the obligation is not applied, as happens in several parts of Southern Italy. On the other hand, in some mountain areas and in Northern Italy the dates may be changed.
traduzioni.dir_periodo: For the sake of uniformity, the period covered by the obligation is set between 15 November and 15 April, and the order is to be written using the model in annex A.
traduzioni.dir_montagna: Road owners may still adopt measures of the same kind with a different period for roads or road sections in special conditions, such as mountain roads at very high altitude.
traduzioni.pol_gomme: Snow tyres (also called winter or thermal tyres), which the Highway Code treats as an alternative to snow chains, carry a marking such as M+S, MS, M-S or M&S and certain speed category symbols.
traduzioni.pol_catene: With all other types of tyres you must carry chains on board.
traduzioni.dir_assi: To avoid different readings about the use of anti-skid devices, the directive makes clear that they must be fitted at least on the wheels of the driving axles.
traduzioni.pol_multa: Driving a vehicle without respecting the obligation to have anti-skid devices or winter tyres fitted (or on board) leads to a fine. There are no additional penalties, but the driver is told not to continue the journey until they have this equipment.

paesi.titolo: Winter Tyres in Austria with a Rental Car (2026-27): Rules and Chains
paesi.chi: Austria's Federal Ministry for Innovation, Mobility and Infrastructure
paesi.risposta: from 1 November to 15 April cars must have winter tyres on all four wheels when there is snow, slush or ice on the road, and snow chains on at least two drive wheels may replace winter tyres only where the road is continually or almost always under snow or ice.

paesi.catene_breve: Instead of winter tyres only on roads under snow or ice

citazioni.x: From 1 November to 15 April of the following year, passenger cars are subject to a situational winter equipment obligation.
That means that drivers using the roads in wintry conditions during this period must have winter tyres fitted.
When there is snow, slush or ice on the roads, private cars and goods vehicles up to 3.5 tonnes must be equipped for winter driving conditions with winter tyres fitted on all four wheels.
Winter tyres are recognised as such in law if they bear the markings "Matsch und Schnee" (German for "mud/slush and snow"), commonly abbreviated to: M+S, M.S. or M&S.

In addition, tyres on private cars and goods vehicles up to a maximum gross vehicle weight of 3.5 tonnes must have a tread depth of at least 4 millimetres in the case of radial tyres (commonest type) and 5 millimetres in the case of cross-ply tyres.

Private cars and goods vehicles up to a maximum gross vehicle weight of 3.5 tonnes may use snow chains instead of winter tyres. Chains must be fitted to at least two drive wheels. But this is only permitted where the road is continually or almost always under snow or ice.
Driving in winter road conditions without winter tyres or snow chains incurs a fine of € 35. If other road users are endangered as a result, fines of up to € 5 000 may be imposed.
This means that anyone who has an accident whilst driving with summer tyres must prove that the accident would still have happened if winter tyres or chains had been fitted.

paesi.chi: Service-Public.fr, the French government's information site
paesi.risposta: from 1 November 2026 to 31 March 2027, in the mountain towns listed by the prefects of 34 departments and marked by road signs, cars must either carry snow chains or snow socks for at least 2 drive wheels or have 4 winter tyres; the rule applies only in those mountain areas.

citazioni.x: Il est obligatoire, dans certaines zones montagneuses, d'équiper son véhicule de pneus hiver ou de détenir des chaînes ou des chaussettes à neige durant la période hivernale.

Les préfets de 34 départements situés dans des massifs montagneux (Alpes, Corse, Massif central, Jura, Pyrénées, Vosges) doivent établir la liste des communes dans lesquelles un équipement des véhicules devient obligatoire en « période hivernale », c'est-à-dire du 1er novembre au 31 mars.

Un panonceau précise la période hivernale, afin de rappeler aux usagers que ces obligations ne s’appliquent que du 1er novembre au 31 mars. La signalisation est nécessaire pour que la mesure soit opposable.

Entre le 1er novembre 2026 et le 31 mars 2027, les véhicules légers, les utilitaires et les camping-cars doivent, dans les zones établies par les préfets de départements: soit détenir des dispositifs antidérapants amovibles permettant d’équiper « au moins 2 roues motrices » (chaînes à neige métalliques recommandées en cas d’usage fréquent de votre véhicule au sein de ces zones, chaussettes à neige textiles en cas d’usage occasionnel); soit être équipés de 4 pneumatiques adaptés à la conduite hivernale (pneus hiver).
Vous devez vérifier que les dispositifs amovibles sont adaptés à la taille de vos roues et à l'espace entre la roue et la carrosserie.

Seuls les pneus 3PMSF sont admis en équivalence aux dispositifs antidérapants amovibles (3PMSF est l'acronyme de « Three peak mountain snow flake » qui signifie « Montagne à trois pics avec un flocon de neige »).
L’achat et l’utilisation d’autres types de pneus neige restent possibles, mais les usagers doivent dans ce cas détenir également des dispositifs antidérapants amovibles.
Cette obligation ne s'applique pas aux véhicules équipés de pneus à clous.

traduzioni.zone: In some mountain areas you must fit winter tyres to your vehicle or carry snow chains or snow socks during the winter period.
traduzioni.prefetti: The prefects of 34 departments in mountain ranges (Alps, Corsica, Massif Central, Jura, Pyrenees, Vosges) must draw up the list of towns where vehicle equipment becomes mandatory in the “winter period”, that is from 1 November to 31 March.
traduzioni.cartelli: A plate under the sign shows the winter period, to remind road users that these obligations only apply from 1 November to 31 March. The signs are needed for the rule to be enforceable.
traduzioni.obblighi: Between 1 November 2026 and 31 March 2027, cars, vans and motorhomes must, in the areas set by the prefects of departments, either carry removable anti-skid devices for “at least 2 drive wheels” (metal snow chains are recommended if you often drive in these areas, textile snow socks for occasional use), or have 4 tyres suited to winter driving (winter tyres).
traduzioni.misura: You must check that the removable devices fit the size of your wheels and the space between the wheel and the bodywork.
traduzioni.3pmsf: Only 3PMSF tyres are accepted as equivalent to removable anti-skid devices (3PMSF stands for “Three peak mountain snow flake”, which means “mountain with three peaks and a snowflake”).
traduzioni.altri_pneus: You can still buy and use other types of snow tyres, but in that case you must also carry removable anti-skid devices.
traduzioni.chiodi: This obligation does not apply to vehicles with studded tyres.

citazioni.x: In Switzerland, there is no legal obligation to fit your vehicle with winter tyres. However, drivers must always maintain control of their vehicle.

Zakona o sigurnosti prometa na cestama (NN 67/08, 48/10, 74/11, 80/13, 158/13, 92/14, 64/15, 108/17, 70/19, 42/20, 85/22, 114/22, 133/23) zimski uvjeti podrazumijevaju kolnik prekriven snijegom ili kad je na kolniku poledica. Zimskom opremom motornih vozila kategorije M i N čija najveća dopuštena masa nije veća od 3,5 t sukladno ovom Pravilniku, smatraju se zimski pneumatici (M+S) na svim kotačima ili ljetni pneumatici s najmanjom dubinom profila od 4 mm i s lancima za snijeg koji se postavljaju na pogonske kotače.
